result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: addGuests.handler.ts carefully computes `uniqueGuests` (excluding existing attendees) and uses it for DB insertion, but then calls `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the raw input. In email-manager.ts, `sendAddGuestsEmails` checks `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` and sends `AttendeeScheduledEmail` (a full new-booking invite) to matches, otherwise the add-guests notice. So an email already an attendee that was re-submitted lands in the `guests` list, is filtered out of `uniqueGuests` (no DB change), yet still receives a fresh scheduled-booking ema
